In addition, Shizako can be started automatically on boot. If not, please check if your system or third-party tools have restricted Shizako.

A few quick settings and Shizako is ready to use.

1. Provided "as is"

Shizako is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose. The developer is not responsible for any device damage, data loss, or system malfunction resulting from using this app or granting apps access to Shizako.

2. It grants real privilege

Shizako runs a privileged service on your device (shell / root identity), or makes Shizako itself the Device Owner. Authorized apps gain near-system capabilities: freezing or uninstalling apps, changing system settings, reading/writing protected data. Only authorize apps you trust, and check where they come from.

3. Device Owner side effects

After activating Device Owner: Shizako cannot be uninstalled or downgraded until the Device Owner role is removed; only one Device Owner can exist per device; activation requires no accounts or secondary users (accounts can be restored afterwards).

4. Root risks

If you start Shizako with root, the risks of rooting itself (system integrity, warranty, malware abuse) are yours to bear.

5. Third-party behavior

Actions performed by third-party apps through Shizako, and their consequences, are between you and those apps. Shizako only provides the channel.

6. License

Apache License 2.0, based on RikkaApps/Shizuku. Use at your own risk — you can stop using Shizako at any time.

Do I need to activate again after a reboot?

Root: yes, start again after each boot (or enable \"Start on boot\" in settings). Wireless debugging / computer ADB: yes, the service stops on reboot. Dhizuku: no, Device Owner persists across reboots.
Root if the device is rooted; Wireless debugging for Android 11+ without a computer; computer ADB if you have a PC; Dhizuku if you want a one-time setup that survives reboots.

Check that Wireless debugging is still enabled (some ROMs turn it off when the screen locks), that the pairing code and port are the latest ones shown, and that the device stays on the network. On MIUI, also enable \"USB debugging (Security settings)\".
